title: dests.snapshot
description: v0.5 (docs/14 §7.2): capture destinations the device may offer, sorted by slot. The device caches the last one (/cfg/dests.json) and reports its rev in revs.dests; it only displays rows and resolves letters, cpad decides every delivery again. Sent only to firmware whose revs carry dests.

rev.description: content hash: CRC-32 of the rows' canonical JSON, 1 when that is 0; equal revs mean equal rows, also across a cpad restart

dests.description: only usable destinations (enabled, with an executor in this cpad, opted in when they leave the Mac)

kind.description: the part of id before the dot; a pattern, not an enum: the device shows a kind it does not know and acts on fl only (docs/25 §4.6)

key.description: bound letter; the device binds only its own letter table (docs/14 §3.1) and takes the first row when a letter repeats

fl.description: docs/25 §2.2 flags, letters in this order: l live (only while you are there; offline captures wait in 等你), c the text leaves this Mac, p needs a project, k each capture is confirmed on the device after reading it all. cpad always sends it, "" included; the device ignores letters it does not know and reads a row without fl (or with null) as "lck"

destId.description: built-in id or <kind>.<name>, the name at most 12 characters (docs/25 §2.2): always inside limits.json dest_pattern

label.description: 1..24 UTF-8 bytes without control characters, '"' or '\\', so it never needs escaping on the wire
